title: Explicit failed-candidate supersession after successor validation
failure_signature: A detailed validator passed 54 of 55 checks because three failed transport methods remained candidates after a working successor became available.
candidate_workaround: Promote the validated successor, then mark each failed candidate superseded with an explicit successor while retaining all state events, failed witnesses, and negatives.
recurrence_guard: After successor validation, require no failed workaround to remain candidate and never delete its history.
rollback: If the successor later fails compatibility, deprecate it explicitly and open a new candidate; do not rewrite prior failed or superseded events.
scope_boundary: Workflow recommendation state only; supersession does not erase failure or broaden the successor's evidence scope.
